uncited: HDDA Hybrid is a ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel grids that combines hierarchical skipping with fine-grained traversal.
It builds on [Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA)](1122-hierarchical-digital-differential-analyzer-hdda.md).
**Outputs:** A sequence of sample points $(t, \mathbf{x})$ along the ray within occupied regions.
- **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
- **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
HDDA Hybrid was introduced in the context of accelerating occupancy grid-based NeRF rendering using VDB grids.
